features:
🚀 Zynx Hub | Oil Empire

Automate smarter. Build faster. Dominate the market.

Zynx Hub is a premium automation hub for Oil Empire, built for players who want a cleaner, faster, and more strategic way to grow their operation. From refinery scouting to market timing, every feature is designed to keep your empire moving.

⚡ Features

- 🤖 Smart Auto Steal  
  Scans enemy refineries, prioritizes valuable targets, respects cooldowns, and returns to your base automatically.

- ⛽ Auto Collect  
  Keeps your drills, refineries, and solar panels from sitting idle while you focus on expansion.

- 💸 Market-Aware Selling  
  Monitor live gas prices, set your desired sell price, enable Auto Sell, or sell instantly with one click.

- 🛒 Live Shop Scanner  
  Track available drills and refineries in real time. View item name, price, and stock directly in the hub.

- 📦 One-Click Purchases  
  Select stocked drills or refineries and purchase them without navigating the in-game shop interface.

- 🚀 Movement Utilities  
  Custom Walk Speed, Jump Height, Anti-AFK, and quick teleports to key locations.

- 🌐 Server Utility  
  Auto Server Hop helps you find new opportunities when your current server is empty or inactive.

- 📞 Quick Actions  
  Repeat your last phone sale, redeem codes, manage your session, and keep your workflow fast.

- 📱 Built for Every Device  
  Responsive layout, mobile touch support, draggable interface, and persistent settings.

Zynx Hub — Drill. Refine. Sell. Expand.
